method: headless managed Chromium; renderState called with synthetic 500 conversations, 34 agents, 50 tasks, 200 audit rows; panels first forced offscreen then visible
note: renderState only calls renderTasks/renderAudit when the corresponding panel is visible. The IntersectionObserver triggers a sync when a panel enters the viewport, which then renders it. First-time card creation accounts for most of the 19 ms difference; steady-state polls additionally skip the signature work.

autoforge.scope: adapter-reported build/test only; no runtime or deployment claim
limitations: operator-owned adapters run outside a sandbox
test_pass covers the targeted acceptance subset; the full node --test suite was run separately
browser behavior was verified manually in headless Chromium; the node suite does not execute public/app.js.
